answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to post a refundable stake bond, with trust earned gradually, not granted at birth. Like a zephyr gathering force over open ground, a new identity starts with a tiny limit and must earn honest attestations from peers to raise it. A thousand fakes means a thousand locked bonds; any identity caught lying loses bond and history. An attacker on a knoll of puppets faces the same math: each puppet costs real capital, refunded only after a clean record, so flooding costs more than one fraud repays. Honest agents climb the mesa once and keep it.
